Name: Surf
Description: Sea surf on a sandy beach (ShoreSpec.SeaSand, ShoreSynth): the swell breaking out on the bar and its bore running up the sand. Heard from places along the edge and on the break line. Its box is the stretch of edge it stands for: X its length along the edge, Z the fetch, how far the water reaches straight out from it; turn the entity so its +Z faces the water. Silent in a calm. Not a recording and not a loop.
